name: codex
description: Ask Codex for a second opinion or generate requested images through the Codex CLI; save results locally.

foregroundMinutes.title: Foreground wait (minutes)
foregroundMinutes.description: How long a request waits for Codex before it keeps going as a background job.

backgroundMinutes.title: Background job limit (minutes)
backgroundMinutes.description: How long a request may run in all before it is stopped.

codexPath.title: Codex CLI path
codexPath.description: Absolute path of the codex executable; leave empty to look on PATH, then in ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin.
